name: Community Resources
description:
Community services around Stratford, PEI. Libraries shows the Stratford Public Library and the little free libraries around town. Food has the grocery stores, MacKenzie Farm Market, the Community Fridge and the Community Garden. Health shows the medical centres, dental clinics and pharmacies.

Community Spaces shows halls and meeting rooms, from the Mayflower Centre to the Waterfront Pavilion, and Places of Worship shows the churches and Kingdom Hall. Emergency marks the Emergency Services Centre and Town Hall, and EV Chargers shows the four EV chargers in town. Click a pin for the address and details.

properties.description: In a major storm or a long power outage, this can open as a reception centre: a warm place with water, washrooms and power to charge your phone. To see which centres are open, call 211 or check the [[https://www.princeedwardisland.ca/en/information/justice-and-public-safety/reception-centres|Province's list]]. In an emergency, call 911.

properties.What: 87 garden plots for rent (6 more in Stonington). Two plots grow free produce for the community.
properties.Address: Bunbury Road, across from Cotton Park
properties.Hours: May 15 to October 31, dawn to dusk
properties.description: Run by the Town and the Stratford Area Watershed Improvement Group. Returning gardeners renew by early February; new gardeners sign up from mid February, with Stratford residents first.
